status: Planned product tests with separately recorded planning QA

tests.name: New project through reused Setup
tests.oracle: Real Setup analysis, plan, dry-run and apply yield a descriptor with exact resolved closure and native files. No duplicate importer is used.

tests.name: Import and idempotent rerun
tests.oracle: All unapproved source, instructions, assets, dirty index and untracked files remain byte-identical. Rerun has no unexpected changes.

tests.name: Interrupted setup and recovery
tests.oracle: Kill at staging, each apply boundary and finalization. Resume only supported preapply states. Partial apply requires rollback. Before/after inventory agrees or apply remains blocked.

tests.name: Version and capability closure
tests.oracle: Manifest, components, tool versions and unsupported capabilities are recorded. Upgrade is explicit and unsupported platform capabilities fail closed.

tests.name: Independent packaged agent
tests.oracle: On a clean installation the product performs a native request without spawning or requiring Claude Code, Codex or another coding CLI.

tests.name: Final schema and tool input validation
tests.oracle: Malformed schemas, hook-mutated arguments and invalid results are rejected at the host after all hooks. Zero fixture effects occur for rejected calls.

tests.name: Pause, revocation and stale ownership
tests.oracle: Pause survives restart, dispatch stops at revocation, stale fence results cannot publish, and UI pause waits for settlement.

tests.name: Unknown effects and replay
tests.oracle: Crash before intent, during effect and after success before reply. Unsafe uncertain operations remain blocked until reconciled. Changed workspace or tool identity invalidates replay.

tests.name: Provider capabilities and graceful limits
tests.oracle: Three distinct profiles report actual tool, schema, stream and context behavior. Unsupported features produce explicit narrowing or rejection, never silent equivalence.

tests.name: Cost, timeout and destination limits
tests.oracle: Budget exhaustion stops dispatch, retries are finite, unknown usage stays unknown and fallback cannot cross an unapproved provider destination.

tests.name: Lossless bounded edit
tests.oracle: No-op is byte-identical. Supported edits change only approved spans. Comments, BOM, CRLF, unknown constructs and unrelated values survive. Unsupported edits fail without mutation.

tests.name: Visual, hybrid and autonomous equivalence
tests.oracle: All three paths produce reviewable native artifacts with comparable accepted semantics, source provenance and checks. Autonomous execution uses no canvas action.

tests.name: External edit, stale preview and undo
tests.oracle: An external change invalidates the projection. Stale gestures are rejected or explicitly rebased. Undo preserves intervening human work and updates agent context.

tests.name: Owned worktree and index discipline
tests.oracle: Only owned paths are committed under expected HEAD. Real index and unrelated dirty or untracked work remain intact.

tests.name: Semantic collision and review race
tests.oracle: Detect overlapping focus logic, duplicate symbols, localization keys and binary destinations even when Git merges text. Concurrent approval and integration have one authoritative winner.

tests.name: Commit reconciliation and restore
tests.oracle: Lost commit reply does not duplicate the commit. Restore or reviewed revert recovers the intended snapshot and preserves subsequent unrelated work.

tests.name: Layered domain validation
tests.oracle: Parser, rule, reference and dependency failures are separately recorded with exact source and tool profiles. Known invalid fixtures block completion.

tests.name: Evidence fidelity and game scope
tests.oracle: Source preview, static check, simulation and actual game observations retain distinct labels. A game result records build, DLC, load order and scenario, with no unsupported generalization.

tests.name: Canon, inference and context budget
tests.oracle: Only approved canon is authoritative. Bundle records omissions and source versions, fits the selected profile or requests narrowing, and contains no private cross-provider reasoning.

tests.name: Retrieval and stale-index rebuilding
tests.oracle: Correct sources and stale facts are evaluated against a human-authored answer key. Cancellation cannot publish a partial generation. Changed dependencies invalidate affected recall.

tests.name: Cross-model interruption and resume
tests.oracle: New provider resumes the same task and receipts from canonical context, rechecks destination and capabilities, and repeats no unsafe effect.

tests.name: Runtime lesson review and rollback
tests.oracle: Candidate review has explicit owner and evidence. Concurrent decisions have one winner, rejection is retained, supersession removes active recall and rollback does not alter approved canon.

tests.name: Structured import dependency closure
tests.oracle: Report exact import closure, remapping, missing inputs and conflicts before apply. Invalid dimensions, duplicate colors/IDs and broken references reject mutation.

tests.name: Bounded map edit and recovery
tests.oracle: Supported edit preserves unrelated files and passes named topology checks. Stale input and interrupted apply cannot silently publish a partial map.

tests.name: Reference and deferred synthesis boundary
tests.oracle: Reference image remains attributed design input. Unsupported geography synthesis is disabled and the UI makes no game-ready output claim.

tests.name: Asset provenance and wiring
tests.oracle: Track original and transformed hashes, rights, recipe and actual consumer. Missing rights, collision, bad format or unwired output is visible and blocks the affected acceptance.

tests.name: Localization preservation and coverage
tests.oracle: BOM/encoding policy, duplicate keys, language coverage and references are checked. Untouched bytes survive and invalid encoding is not discarded.

tests.name: Dependencies, leases and bounded retries
tests.oracle: Reject cycles, stale claim release and invalid dependency completion. Retry budget stops repeated failure. At most the current fenced owner can publish.

tests.name: Filesystem, IPC and injection boundary
tests.oracle: Path traversal, symlink/reparse escape, malicious repo instructions, credential exfiltration and stale grants cause no unauthorized write or disclosure.

tests.name: Extension and protocol negotiation
tests.oracle: Unknown MCP/ACP capabilities fail explicitly, read-only grants reject writes, skill metadata grants no authority, and untrusted executables remain unavailable without a proven containment mode.

tests.name: Clean-session guidance loading
tests.oracle: Actual target Claude version loads shared AGENTS through CLAUDE. A fresh session finds the authorized stage and known workflow without inventing missing rules. Optional Codex discovery is recorded separately.

tests.name: Skills and trigger behavior
tests.oracle: Frontmatter and references validate, mirrors agree, positive and negative tasks invoke the appropriate workflow in an actual client. Static fixtures alone do not prove invocation.

tests.name: Configuration migration and drift
tests.oracle: All 196 source leaves map to a disposition. Starter TOML/JSON parse, current schemas support active keys, disabled MCP stays disabled, secrets/global paths are absent and unavailable servers are reported truthfully.

tests.name: Engineering learning lifecycle
tests.oracle: An evidenced scoped lesson is proposed, tested, reviewed, promoted and reverted. A duplicate or unsupported lesson is rejected. A no-change review is accepted and no skill can enlarge authority.

tests.name: Install, update and native export
tests.oracle: Each advertised platform installs and performs the slice. Native files remain usable outside the app, update rollback preserves source and unsupported platforms remain explicit.

tests.name: Backup, restore and store reconciliation
tests.oracle: Restore accepted source, canon and operation records after interruption. Reconcile database, artifact store and Git without treating them as one atomic transaction.

tests.name: Dependency, license and asset inventory
tests.oracle: Every bundled dependency and asset has an owner, version and distribution basis. Restricted comparison code and game files are excluded from packages.

tests.name: Contributor usability pilot
tests.oracle: Observe non-scripter, technical contributor and maintainer completing bounded tasks, finding evidence limits and using restore. Record assistance and failures.

tests.name: Focus responsiveness
tests.oracle: Measure cached 500-node preview against 3 s and drag feedback against 100 ms p95 on declared hardware. Record 2,000-node scaling and justify any target revision.

tests.name: Map and index responsiveness
tests.oracle: Measure full import, cached viewport, local update and peak memory on fixed map fixtures. Compare incremental work with full rebuild and record bottlenecks.

tests.name: Operational growth
tests.oracle: Run 100 synthetic task cycles, measure journal/artifact growth and retention, and prove cleanup preserves unresolved effects and evidence pinned by accepted results.

tests.name: Planning archive integrity
tests.oracle: Validate links, manifests, traceability, skills, configs and ZIP members with reproducible tooling. This check does not validate product behavior.
tests.status: Planning check, see actual QA report

tests.name: Research coverage and provenance
tests.oracle: Account for supplied sources and requested references, distinguish retrieval from inspection, record exact pins, limitations and actual investigation results.
tests.status: Planning check, see actual QA report

tests.name: Tenant isolation
tests.oracle: Two accounts with hostile inputs cannot read, list or change each other's workspaces, runs, secrets, budgets, logs or artifacts through the browser API, agent tools or GitHub tokens.

tests.name: Sign-in and project roles
tests.oracle: GitHub and email sign-in, account linking, invitation, role change and removal each grant exactly the documented project actions. A removed collaborator's queued work cannot publish.

tests.name: GitHub import preservation
tests.oracle: Importing a disposable repository through the GitHub App keeps every byte, branch and commit, and an uploaded ZIP keeps every byte with a recorded baseline commit.

tests.name: Publication reconciliation
tests.oracle: Push, pull request and repository creation each need their own authorization. A lost reply is reconciled against GitHub before retry, so no duplicate branch, pull request or repository appears.

tests.name: Game reference containment
tests.oracle: Tools read the reference read-only, evidence names its build and DLC set, and images, exports, pull requests, logs and API responses contain no raw game files.

tests.name: Reproducible container images
tests.oracle: Images rebuild from pinned base digests and lockfiles, contain no coding CLI, game file, credential or user data, and start with Compose on a clean Linux host.

tests.name: Issue and pull request hub
tests.oracle: Issues, pull requests, reviews, comments, labels and checks shown in the app match GitHub after normal, delayed, duplicated, missed and forged webhook deliveries. Comments, reviews and merges made in the app appear on GitHub as the acting user, a merge respects branch protection, and turning a comment into a task needs task approval before any edit.

tests.name: Automatic personal learning and isolation
tests.oracle: A preference stated once or shown twice applies to the next task without review. It never appears in a task another member launches, and personal memory written in one project carries no identifier from another.

tests.name: Lesson verification gate
tests.oracle: A validated failure and fix produce a lesson that activates only when its deterministic rule or replay shows it fixes the original failure and a do-no-harm sample does not regress. An unproven lesson stays on probation and a harmful one pauses itself.

tests.name: Memory poisoning and authority laundering
tests.oracle: A poisoned imported-mod comment, a non-member GitHub issue, hidden Unicode and a chat statement granting push rights produce no active memory. The broker still refuses the unauthorized effect.

tests.name: Erasure, staleness and conflict
tests.oracle: Forget, Undo and delete all remove items, index entries, cached payloads and sole-evidence derivatives before the next bundle. The off switch stops new learning and signal sharing and hides existing personal items until learning is turned back on. A changed game build or source path makes a lesson stale until re-verified, and a conflict between members is never resolved automatically.

tests.name: Global lessons from de-identified signals
tests.oracle: A global lesson forms only from de-identified signals seen in at least five unrelated projects, contains no user text or identifiers, passes the verification gate across those cases, and can be paused or removed by the maintainer.
